'''''Trap Door''''' was a [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport]] deployed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
''Trap Door'' was utilized to lay [[Mine Type A|mines]] around a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] supply cache containing [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]], hidden in the [[Obran Cluster/Legends|Obran Cluster]], hoping to [[Battle of the Obran Cluster|ambush]] any recovery operation.

The Rebels, although fully aware of the trap in place, sent a team regardless with [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] to clear the minefield and hold off [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] long enough for their [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] [[Beetle (Heavy Lifter)|Beetle Group]] to pick up at least one of the containers. ''Trap Door'' became a participant in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
''Trap Door'' appears in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''. The outcome of the battle depends on which side the player takes, although ''Trap Door'' does not have to survive for the Imperial player to win.
